current_profile_snapshot.scope_note: Broad New Age baseline; rhythmic/progressive/neo-classical subprofiles may override.
current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: low-to-moderate rhythmic aggression; pulse may be flowing, sparse, arpeggiated or absent
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: longer melodic arcs, breath/release space, gradual entrances and exits
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: spacious tonal/modal harmony; add9/maj7/sus/open voicings common as options, not requirements
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: structural support with long tones, gentle motion or pedal behavior; avoid rigid repeated two-hit templates
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: optional light percussion; when present favor supportive texture over dominant backbeat unless subtype says otherwise
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: piano/electric piano/synth, flute, guitar, harp, strings, choir/textures as target resources; role separation foreground vs depth
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: continuous expressive shaping and low masking between melody and pads/textures
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: slow evolution of texture, register, orchestration and space; silence is valid material
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: legato and sustained articulation favored, with soft attacks where the selected instrument supports them
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: phrase-level microtiming and tempo breathing; repetition must evolve
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: continuous expression, pedal, attack/release and ambience controls when target supports them
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: reverb/depth intentional; avoid washing out foreground definition
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: clear foreground/background depth with broad spatial field
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: smooth, open, low-harshness master; transient restraint unless subtype requires more activity
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prefer expressive target voices; preserve continuous controller curves and long releases
provenance: AllMusic New Age reference already recorded in project
